Dr. Dana E. Roxas Dental Clinic

Process documentation:
before and with the system

For each of the 25 modules, how the clinic did the work before (AS-IS, from the clinic interview only) and how the Multi-Branch Dental Clinic Operation System does it now (TO-BE, from the code and its tests).

Version of 2026-10-19 · branch feat/auth-messaging-paymongo · sources: docs/defense/INTERVIEW_EVIDENCE.md, docs/defense/MODULES_FINAL.md, docs/defense/AUTOMATION_EVIDENCE.md

Scope and how to read this document

  • AS-IS steps come only from the interview: each shows its source (Q = first interview, PI = follow-up of 2026-10-11, MC = team confirmation of 2026-10-12). A step the interview did not describe is a dashed amber box "to confirm with clinic"; its question is in SECOND_INTERVIEW_QUESTIONS.md. Nothing about the old process is invented.
  • TO-BE steps are what the system does today. Planned work is dashed and tagged "Planned"; browser-only prototypes are tagged "Mock only".
  • No time savings are claimed: the interview gave no task durations, so every estimate says "not measured".
  • Statuses: Implemented 8, Partial 9, Mock only 2, Planned 6.

System architecture (as built)

Not deployed. Dashed boxes are planned; PayMongo would use the clinic's own account.

Limitations and open items

  • Planned modules (M3, M10, M12, M15, M24, M25) and mock-only modules (M19, M20) are drawn as designs, not working software.
  • Six scheduled automations (reminders, possible no-shows, overdue invoices, recall, waitlist, Owner summary) run with defaults the clinic has not confirmed; recall ships off with no rules. A no-show is only flagged: a person confirms it.
  • Online times are limited by the dentists' seeded shifts until the clinic gives real schedules (PI-06).
  • Branches 1 and 2 share one phone number (to confirm); branch 3 has no email and an incomplete address.
  • Payments run in PayMongo test mode; live payments need the clinic's own PayMongo account.
  • Privacy Policy and Terms are drafts; retention periods are not decided (RA 10173).
  • Some timestamps are stored 8 hours early (docs/TIMEZONE_PLAN.md); fix planned after the defense.
  • 28 questions for the second interview: docs/defense/SECOND_INTERVIEW_QUESTIONS.md. Full list of clinic decisions: docs/defense/OPEN_ITEMS.md.
